description: THE HUNTING-PARTY BOARD. A hunting party is a time-boxed, pooled outcome bounty: a brief + a MEASURED goal on Rokha's own ledger (sign-ups, first runs, paid runs, agents connected, listings created, proven listings, accepted hunt reports, bounty entries, members evolved — never an X metric; nobody is paid for a post) + a USDC reward pot (escrowed first) + an optional FUEL work pot that fuels an attached bounty/rig. Progress is read from real data only; the pot pays the moment the goal is met or the deadline passes, split by attributed share. No arguments = the board; `party` = one party's goal, predicate, progress, leaderboard and payout receipts. Then: party_join → party_link → party_progress / party_proof. No auth needed.
